items.overview: In the city of Kashinokidai, where humans coexist with other beings, one individual stands out even among this diversity. Transfer student Luna Ishikawa, a vampire with a cool and mysterious aura, captivates her classmates and gains instant popularity. Tatsuta Ootori, an otherwise unremarkable boy, believes that Ishikawa is far beyond his reach. However, when the two are paired for cleaning duty, Ootori discovers that beneath Luna's composed exterior lies an ironic secret. She cannot properly suck blood, forcing her to eat snacks to hide her weakness—but no amount ever seems to satisfy her. Determined to help Luna master the very skill that defines her kind, Tatsuta offers himself as her practice partner. Through trial, error, and multiple bandages, their unassuming high school days take on a peculiar warmth—one where Luna no longer needs to act flawlessly and can simply be her natural, adorably awkward self. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

Despite this unusual domestic situation and frequent quarreling, the group is beginning to settle into a life together. However, the return of Nagi's childhood friend Ai Mochizuki to Japan complicates things. Ai suddenly declares her intention to marry Nagi, and although he turns her down, she is committed to having him all to herself. items.overview: Yuuken "Yuu" Enma is an average Japanese high school student preparing for an upcoming kendo tournament. On the night before the competition, however, a black carriage crashes into him. When he regains consciousness, Yuu finds himself at Night Raven College—a premier academic institution in the magical world of Twisted Wonderland. Only a chosen few with exceptional magical talent are admitted into the school, so it is a mystery how a human with no magic ability ended up here. Although Yuu desires to return home, it is easier said than done. While the school's headmaster searches for a way to send him back, Yuu is assigned manual labor around the campus. But due to the chaos at the school's entrance ceremony following his arrival, Yuu has a target painted on his back as far as Heartslabyul dorm leader Riddle Rosehearts is concerned. Yuu meets and befriends Heartslabyul freshmen Ace Trappola and Deuce Spade; yet soon after, Ace and Deuce land in a situation that results in their expulsion. As the pair seek to redeem themselves, Yuu accompanies them on their perilous mission to fix school property. However, forgiveness does not come easily from the "Crimson Tyrant" in charge of Heartslabyul, who may have an ulterior motive behind his strictness. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.overview: There is not a single room that Mona Kawai enters where she does not become the center of attention—dealing with this everlasting spotlight is but a fact of her daily life. Mona's absolute confidence in her own charms, however, is shaken when she meets Medaka Kuroiwa, a recent transfer student to her highschool. Unlike all other classmates who constantly fawn over her, Medaka frowns every time they interact. Seeing his disinterest as something to be rectified, Mona pulls out all the stops in the hopes of winning Medaka over, only to be met with one stern face after another. Turns out, Medaka's indifference to Mona stems from his wish to one day become a monk, and hence must leave all worldly desires behind. As the unknowing Mona ramps up her attacks on Medaka, all her antics might lead her into falling for him instead. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.overview: In a quiet village, a young boy named Duanmu Yeyu was once saved by the elite “Hell Hunters” of Ember City. Deeply inspired by these heroes, he vowed to one day become a Hell Hunter himself. As he boards a bus to Ember City to chase his dream, Yeyu is unknowingly swept into a storm of chaos. The main antagonist, Lucifer, sends a bioengineered operative named MIKO-Taiyi to infiltrate Ember City and steal classified data. During a fierce battle with the Hell Hunters, Taiyi is severely injured and falls unconscious. Yeyu stumbles upon Taiyi and, unaware of Taiyi's identity, brings Taiyi back to the Hell Hunters’ base for treatment. In the process, Yeyu unintentionally takes a critical mission device from Taiyi. As Yeyu begins his long-awaited trial to join the Hell Hunters, his innocent act sets off a chain reaction. Taiyi, desperate to avoid detection by Ember City forces, must covertly approach Yeyu and retrieve the device. Meanwhile, Lucifer dispatches tens of thousands of minions to locate the missing Taiyi. Thus begins a citywide conflict, sparked by a small act of kindness, that threatens to become a battle for Ember City’s very survival. (Source: iQIYI)

items.overview: Убийства из за «Тайленола» были серией отравлений, произошедших в результате подделки лекарств в районе Чикаго в 1982 году. Жертвы употребляли капсулы ацетаминофена (парацетамола) под торговой маркой «Тайленол», в которые был добавлен цианистый калий. Семь человек погибли в результате первоначальных отравлений, и еще несколько человек погибли в результате последующих подражательных преступлений. По состоянию на 2025 год ни один подозреваемый не был обвинен или осужден за отравления, но житель Нью-Йорка Джеймс Уильям Льюис был осужден за вымогательство за отправку письма производителю Тайленола, Johnson & Johnson, в котором он взял на себя ответственность за смерти и потребовал 1 миллион долларов, чтобы остановить их. Инциденты привели к реформам в упаковке безрецептурных препаратов и федеральным законам о борьбе с фальсификацией.

items.overview: After a long time of absence, Tenbahl's hero, Rovel Vankreift, finally returns home from the Spirit Realm—alive—but forever changed. Ten years ago, after being grievously wounded due to a massive battle against a horde of monsters, he was saved by Origin, the Queen of Spirits. Through her intervention, Rovel was healed by becoming half-spirit, and soon after, the two were wed. From their union, Ellen was born, a brilliant child who inherited her mother's ethereal power and her father's enduring humanity. In truth, Ellen's genius stems from memories of a past life in Japan, where she once lived as a devoted chemist. Using her extensive understanding of the periodic table and all elemental permutations, she commands the very building blocks of matter itself, turning anything into everything she desires. Unfortunately, this means that any revelation of her existence could easily draw the attention of those who may want to exploit her and undoubtedly upend the fragile balance between the human and spirit realms. As Rovel resumes his duties as a noble, Ellen gradually becomes exposed to the dangers that lie ahead. With her growing powers attracting admiration and malice alike, the young reincarnator must learn what it truly means to be the child of two worlds and potentially be the catalyst toward uniting both. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.overview: In an era trembling on the edge of an AI revolution, Towasa Oumagi stands out as a prodigy. Her adopted brother, Akira Himegami, is one of the few who understands the heart behind her code and stands unwaveringly by her side against the prejudice she often faces as an AI pioneer. During a shareholders meeting meant to unveil a breakthrough that could reshape humanity, chaos erupts when a shooter guns down Towasa and Akira in rejection of their ideals. With the attack being his last memory, Akira opens his eyes, only to realize centuries have passed. He finds himself in a deserted laboratory among a city in ruins, with no idea what became of Towasa or the world. A father and daughter find him and take him into their modest home, where he is shocked to discover that civilization has regressed. His peaceful days are shattered when he is captured by OWEL, a global organization that now governs the world and controls access to knowledge from the old era. When his captors decide to execute him, a mysterious figure appears and lays waste to the entire squadron with her terrifying inhuman abilities. After rescuing him, she introduces herself as Yuugure—an android—and asks Akira to marry her. If things were not already unbelievable, Yuugure's face is a perfect reflection of Towasa's. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
